Hello Maria, it's a pleasure to speak with you too.

To help me find the best options for you, could you please confirm your departure city? You mentioned Dublin to London, so I assume Dublin is your departure city. Also, what date would you like to fly?
"Yes, that's correct, my departure city is Dublin and I'd love to fly on a relatively soon date. How about this weekend, specifically Saturday or Sunday?"

Certainly, Maria. I have found several business class flight options from Dublin to London for this weekend.

For Saturday, May 17th, all flights are priced at £249.2:

For Sunday, May 18th, all flights are also priced at £249.2:

To proceed with the booking, could you please confirm your full name and provide your email address?

"That sounds great, thank you so much! My full name is Maria Gonzalez, and my email address is maria.g@email.com. Can I just confirm that the total cost of the flight, including any fees or taxes, comes out to £249?"

transcript.content: Thank you for calling Sky Airways customer service. My name is Sky, and I'm here to help you today. How can I assist you?

"Hi Sky, thank you for helping me. I'm Maria Gonzalez and I'd like to book a flight from Dublin to London, specifically business class please? I was wondering if there's availability on the next available flight with a window seat?"
Certainly, Maria. I can help you with that. I'll look for business class flights from Dublin to London for you.
"Great, thank you Sky! Could you please also let me know if there's a specific flight number or departure time that would work best for me, and approximately how long in advance I can book?"

Certainly, Maria. For a business class flight from Dublin to London today, May 16th, 2026, the next available flight is AX110, departing at 15:45 and arriving at 17:15. The price for this flight is £249.2.

Regarding how far in advance you can book, I can search for flights up to a year in advance.

Would you like to book flight AX110 for £249.2, and I will request a window seat for you?

"That sounds great, thank you Sky! Yes, please, I'd like to book flight AX110 on May 16th, 2026. Could you also confirm that it's possible to get a window seat, and if so, what's my boarding group for today?"

Thank you, Maria. I will book flight AX110 for you for today, May 16th, 2026, with a window seat preference. The price is £249.2.

Before I finalize the booking, could you please provide your email address so I can send the booking confirmation?

Regarding your boarding group, that information will be available once your booking is confirmed and you have checked in for your flight.
"Thank you Sky! My email address is maria.g@email.com. Can I just confirm again that I've got a window seat on flight AX110, please?"

Thank you, Maria. Your flight AX110 for today, May 16th, 2026, has been successfully booked with a window seat preference.

Your booking reference is BK-7F2CA5. Please make a note of this reference as you will need it for any future changes, cancellations, or to add extras to your booking.

A confirmation email with all the details, including a link for payment, has been sent to maria.g@email.com.

Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
"Perfect, thank you so much!"

evaluation.summary: Agent successfully booked a business class flight from Dublin to London with a window seat preference.
